title: Carman D NDE 3977
content: I had two near death experiences, at five years old and at fifteen. My first near death experience was when I was five years old. I lived in an apartment with my mother and siblings in Chicago, Illinois. My mother who battled from depression was given green and black capsules for her illness. At the time, my mother would hide candy from us and would only give us candy after dinner. I used to see her take medicine in the bathroom and thought that she was taking candy. After she took her medicine, she went and attended to my younger brother and sister. I climbed on top of the sink, opened the medicine cabinet, opened her pills, and swallowed a few. When my mother called for me, I ran from the bathroom and everything around me went black. I don't know how long I was out, (later on, I found out it was almost two hours) my mother did not drive and she called my father from work. I was taken to Cook County Hospital. My near death experience went like this: I was climbing up a long golden ladder up through the clouds, and I was climbing very, very high and at the end of the ladder there was a man (for me, it was God) who met me. He was of medium built with white shoulder length hair, with a white shiny white beard like angel hair and had on a white robe with sash. He took me by my hand and we walked towards a marble bench where he sat me in his lap. I felt very weak and tired from the long climb. As he sat me on his lap and laid in his arms, I reached up, touched his beard with my right hand, and felt the most immense sense of love and understanding (until this day this feeling has never left me). He stood me up and took me by the hand and as we were walking, we went to a white marble room where there was a huge screen and pictures of my life were flashing very fast. In the screen were the most surprising images that have never left me - they were of a previous life. From backward images, I saw myself as a young blond haired young man. I was killed in a car accident and I saw myself leaving the scene with a briefcase walking towards the screen. Before that, I saw that I had lived in a suburb in a pale yellow ranch home with a long driveway. Outside the driveway next to the car, I was saying goodbye to my wife, my almost two-year-old daughter, and son about four years old. After the kisses and goodbyes, I got in my car with my briefcase to go to work. After the review, I was led to another marble room where there was a huge open book on a marble table. My guide sat behind the table and with his index finger pointed in the book, he scanned through the page to see if he found my name on the book. His head lifted up and looked at me, a wave of guilt overwhelmed me. I did something very, very wrong. No one had to judge me. I judged myself and knew I did wrong. My guide spoke to me through my mind and I was shown a picture through a cloud of my mother dead in the center of the floor with my father, brother and sister crying around her. He told me it was not my time and that I had to go back for her. After what was shown to me, I went down very quickly and found myself in the hospital room with doctors and nurses working on me. I had rubber tubes through my nose and was strapped down. I stayed in the hospital for two weeks. Until this day after the review of the previous life, I do not drive a car. Since this near death experience, I have not forgotten this. I also had another near death experience at the age of fifteen since these experiences I always felt that I have one foot in heaven and one foot on earth and not truly or completely here. Judged by Works: 'And I saw the dead, small and great, stand before God; and the books were opened: and another book was opened, which is the book of life: and the dead were judged out of those things which were written in the books, according to their works. And the sea gave up the dead which were in it; and death and hell delivered up the dead which were in them: and they were judged every man according to their works.' My second near death experience was when I was fifteen years old in Hartford, Connecticut. I had gotten out of a day of high school classes and went alone to a dentist appointment to have a molar removed. The dentist had given me ether in a mask for me to breathe into and I was completely out. In the experience, I saw a black and white circle going round and round then there was a noise as if someone had turned off an electrical signal or switch. After hearing the signal turned off, I felt complete detachment from my body and detachment for what I had on earth. I was in a vast black and white circle that turned into a tunnel and was drawn to it in a vacuum going very fast. While going through the tunnel, I heard what sounded to me like a roaring freight train with fast ding, ding, ding sounds. The top pulled me back of my head going very fast into the vast semi-clouded tunnel. As I was going through the tunnel, I also heard wind chimes ringing. As I was midway through the long tunnel, I found myself diverted to a long hallway. There were three large oak doors, one on the left, one across to the right and one going straight. I was drawn to open the first door to the left. When I went inside the room the door closed behind me by itself and I was in pitch black darkness. I was conscious of where I was and it seemed that there were other people there in the dark mumbling. I couldn't understand why I was there and I felt very sad. I was saying in my mind, Jesus, I don't belong here and feeling very sad. I was praying to Jesus for help. As I prayed the Our Father prayer, I saw a pinprick circle of light and the circle was getting larger and larger, as I saw myself in the dentist room. I saw myself, (my body) on the dentist chair with the dentist and nurse violently pulling me and shaking me to wake up. I saw the doctor extremely upset and the nurse very distraught. As I was seeing this I was pulled right back into my body. After going into my body, I was very weak, like a ton of bricks were piled right on top of me, and the dentist and nurse were very upset with me. The nurse right away held my head down by my knees to bring blood flow to my head. I did not go home until about an hour later because of the weakness. This experience was real and it has never left me. I know now that when you die, you lose close attachments to the ones you leave behind and to personal possessions. There is care but not heartache. To me there is a mission why we are here. There was total detachment of feelings, no sorrow, but care, and there is a higher power - one we have no control over.

out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Felt 'complete detachment from my body and detachment for what I had on earth.'

tunnel.movement_other_detail: Described being 'drawn to it in a vacuum going very fast' and 'The top pulled me back of my head going very fast.' Also heard 'a roaring freight train' with 'ding, ding, ding' and 'wind chimes ringing.'

arrival.religious_figure_detail: Jesus was addressed in prayer ('Jesus, I don't belong here').

environment.environment_other_detail: Long golden ladder 'up through the clouds'; 'white marble room'; 'marble bench'; 'long hallway' with 'three large oak doors'; one room was 'pitch black darkness.'

boundary_and_return.mission_detail: Told 'it was not my time and that I had to go back for her' (mother). Also concluded 'there is a mission why we are here.'

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Two events: (1) age 5 accidental ingestion of mother's medication; (2) age 15 dental anesthesia with ether during molar extraction.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Nonstandard elements included a 'long golden ladder' ascent (first NDE), and a hallway with three doors leading to a pitch-black room with mumbling people (second NDE).
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Two NDEs with different sequences: first involved ladder ascent → encounter with God → life review → book/judgment → told to return → rapid return; second involved circle/black-white visuals → tunnel with loud sounds → hallway/doors → dark room → prayer → viewing dentist room/body → return.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: First NDE: climbing a 'long golden ladder up through the clouds.' Life review included explicit 'previous life' scenes and death in a car accident. A 'huge open book' was checked for the experiencer's name. Second NDE: black-and-white circle turning into tunnel; loud electrical-switch-off sound; hallway with three oak doors; entering a door into pitch black with mumbling people; prayer produced expanding pinprick of light leading to view of dentist room.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I was climbing up a long golden ladder up through the clouds.” “I reached up, touched his beard… and felt the most immense sense of love and understanding.” “pictures of my life were flashing very fast… they were of a previous life.” “a wave of guilt overwhelmed me… I judged myself.” “He told me it was not my time and that I had to go back for her.” “I felt complete detachment from my body and detachment for what I had on earth.” “I was in pitch black darkness… other people there in the dark mumbling.” “This experience was real and it has never left me.”
